overview: This Senate resolution congratulates the Minnesota Frost for winning the 2025 Professional Women's Hockey League (PWHL) championship, the team's second title in a row. It notes that the Frost beat the Ottawa Charge in a final series where all four games went to overtime, and recognizes the players, coaches, staff, and fans. It also praises the league for its second season and for passing one million fans in attendance. The Senate agreed to it by unanimous consent on June 18, 2025.
for: Supporters say recognizing back-to-back champions celebrates the athletes' achievement and the growth of professional women's sports.
against: Critics say the resolution is symbolic and doesn't change any law or spending.
